"''So, um, was that your ship?|Mika Grey and Kazuda Xiono|audio=MikasShip-TheRelicRaiders.flac|}} The [[archaeologist]] [[Mika Grey]] owned a '''ship'''. In [[34 ABY]], Grey used the [[Starship|ship]] to travel to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Ashas Ree]] in [[Mika Grey's hunt for relics|search]] of a [[Unidentified Sith relic|Sith relic]]. Two [[Standard day|days]] after she was trapped inside a [[Ashas Ree Sith temple|Sith temple]], Grey was [[Mission to Ashas Ree|rescued]] by a group of individuals. After they exited the temple, the group witnessed an explosion; Grey's ship had been destroyed by the [[First Order]], who had tracked her to the planet. After they defeated the [[First Order Raider|First Order forces]], Grey, without a ship, accompanied the group back to the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. ==History== {{Dialogue|Mika Grey|On to the next problem. How am I getting off this wretched world?|Eila|You can come with us!|Torra Doza|It's the least we can do.|Kazuda Xiono|Uh, yeah, well, as long as you're not bringing any people-vaporizing power sources with you.|audio=MikaDeparting-TheRelicRaiders.flac|attr=Grey, Eila, Doza, and Xiono discuss Grey's way off Ashas Ree|src=}} [[File:MikaGrey-TheRelicRaiders.jpg|thumb|250px|right|The human female Mika Grey (pictured) utilized the ship to travel to Ashas Ree.]] In [[34 ABY]], the [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[archaeologist]] [[Mika Grey]] [[pilot]]ed the [[Starship|ship]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' [[planet]] [[Ashas Ree]] in [[Mika Grey's hunt for relics|search]] of a [[Unidentified Sith relic|Sith relic]] for which she had spent two [[Standard year|years]] searching. When she arrived on Ashas Ree, she landed her ship on the outskirts of an [[Ashas Ree outpost|outpost]] and made her way into a [[Ashas Ree Temple of the Force|Temple of the Force]] built over a [[Ashas Ree Sith temple|Sith temple]]. After Grey raised the [[Sith temple]] and broke inside it, she became trapped. Two [[Standard day|days]] later, Grey was [[Mission to Ashas Ree|rescued]] by a group of individuals consisting of the human [[Kel and Eila's family|siblings]]{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-relic-raider-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "The Relic Raider" - ''Star Wars Resistance''|date=2019-11-18}} [[Kel]] and [[Eila]], the [[Resistance]] member [[Kazuda Xiono]], and the [[astromech droid]] [[CB-23]]. Once they left the temple, the group discovered that their companions, the pilots [[Freya Fenris]] and [[Torra Doza]], had been captured by [[First Order Raider]]s, [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] who sought out [[Sith artifact]]s for [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] and who had also tracked Grey from the astronomical object [[Vargos 9]]. Grey suggested to her rescuers that they accompany her to her ship, though Xiono was unsure how that would be useful to their friends held [[Prisoner|captive]]. Xiono then added that Grey would be lucky if the First Order had not discovered her ship. Following Xiono's remark, they witnessed an explosion; the archaeologist's ship had indeed been found and destroyed by the First Order, forcing the group to devise a new plan. They then noticed that Grey had disappeared. After the Raiders captured the group, Grey revealed herself and activated the [[Sith]] [[Force artifact|relic]], which resulted in the [[trooper]]s' [[death]]s. With the troopers dead, Grey lamented that she would not be able to leave the planet as her ship had been destroyed. Eila, Doza, and Xiono invited Grey to accompany them back to the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' upon which they resided. Grey accepted the offer, and they left for the ''Colossus''. ==Behind the scenes== Mika Grey's ship was first mentioned in "[[The Relic Raiders]]," the seventh episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[November 17]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|The Relic Raiders}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/the-relic-raider|text="The Relic Raider" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Starships]]
